d: Dr. Kadri Gopalnath performs the delectable kriti, ‘Nadaloludai’ - by Thyagaraja (1767-1847) set to rupak talam in this excerpt from the Darbar Festival 2011. This kriti is set to Raag Kalyanavasantham, a minor raga of the Carnatic repertoire. Accompanying him are Jyotsna Srikanth (violin), Bangalore Praveen (mridangam) and RN Prakash (ghatam).
